description: This file defines the MySQLQueryService class, which implements database query operations specific to MySQL, such as checking table existence, retrieving table columns, and indexes within the Fineract project.

classes.name: MySQLQueryService
classes.description: A service class providing MySQL-specific database query functionalities such as checking table existence, retrieving column details, and index information.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current database is MySQL.

methods.name: isTablePresent
methods.description: Determines if a specific table exists in the database.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column details for a specified table.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index details for a specified table.
